title: Temenos MCP Values
description: Values for the Temenos MCP Helm chart. NestJS MCP server wrapping the Temenos DataHub REST API. Exposure uses base chart Gateway API routes (no custom Ingress).

mcpConfig.description: Configuration for the Temenos MCP Server, mapped to environment variables (MCP_API_KEY, TEMENOS_API_BASE_URL, TEMENOS_API_KEY).

apiKey.description: Shared secret protecting the MCP endpoint. The server mounts itself at /<MCP_API_KEY>/mcp and 404s every other path, so this value is the credential and the URL prefix at once: it is required, and there is no unauthenticated surface to fall back on. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Rotating it moves the endpoint, so every configured client has to be updated in the same window. fromSecretProvider is auto-collected into the chart's SecretProviderClass — no separate secretProvider.vaults entry needed.

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Temenos DataHub REST API. Must be https — the API key travels as the apikey header on every request, which templates/_helpers.tpl enforces.

apiKey.description: Temenos API key, sent as the apikey header on every DataHub call. fromSecretProvider is auto-collected into the chart's SecretProviderClass — no separate secretProvider.vaults entry needed.
